description: Source file implementing configuration translation functions for CU-UP units, including config generation, QoS setup, and worker manager configuration.

methods.name: generate_cu_up_config
methods.description: Generates a CU-UP configuration object from a unit config, setting report periods, timers, and test modes.

methods.name: generate_cu_up_qos_config
methods.description: Creates a map of QoS configurations indexed by five_qi, with defaults if no QoS configs are provided.

methods.name: fill_cu_up_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Populates worker manager configuration based on the unit configuration, including executor queues and pcap settings.
